description: The logged-in user's GitHub notifications inbox. Demonstrates the needs_auth outcome: if the user is logged out, the call returns needs_auth and the user should sign in in the open tab, then the agent retries.

needs_auth.hint: Ask the user to sign in to github.com in the open tab, then retry this call.

resolve.prompt: Extract the list of GitHub notifications on this page as [{repo, title, reason, url}]. If the page is a login page, return the JSON string "needs_auth".
